This report does **not** execute any case itself. It invokes
`Rscript tests/run.R` once — the exact command the terminal / a coding
agent runs — and then displays the artifacts of that run: the PNGs and
captured console output in `tests/output/`, plus each case's status
straight from the runner. What you see here is, by construction, what
`run.R` produced. Knit from the package root with:

```
Rscript -e "rmarkdown::render('tests/report.Rmd')"
```

To keep a progress snapshot, rename the resulting `report.html` (e.g.
`report 2026-07-06.html`) and move it into `tests/archive/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# rmarkdown knits with the working directory set to tests/; the runner and
# all artifact paths are relative to the package root, so point knitr there.
if (!file.exists("DESCRIPTION") && file.exists("../DESCRIPTION")) {
  knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load, include=FALSE}
# package-free helpers only — the report never loads Applr, so a stale
# package in the knitting session can never leak into the results
source("tests/_helpers.R")
```

# Snapshot

```{r snapshot, include=FALSE}
# THE single execution of the suite: same entry point, same fresh Rscript
# session, same checks as running it from the terminal.
runner_log <- suppressWarnings(
  system2("Rscript", "tests/run.R", stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
)
status <- read.csv("tests/output/_results.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
n_ok <- sum(status$status == "OK")
```

```{r snapshot-summary, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat(sprintf("**%d / %d cases OK.**\n\n", n_ok, nrow(status)))
not_ok <- status[status$status != "OK", ]
if (nrow(not_ok) > 0) {
  cat("Cases not passing:\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("- `%s` — %s\n", not_ok$id, not_ok$status), sep = "")
} else {
  cat("All cases passing.\n")
}
cat("\n<details><summary>Full runner transcript (exactly what the terminal shows)</summary>\n\n")
cat("````\n")
cat(runner_log, sep = "\n")
cat("\n````\n\n</details>\n")
```

Note: an `OK` on a visual case means it ran, produced a plot, and its
console output matched its snapshot (or was silent) — visual correctness
is still judged by eye against the reference images below.

## Show

```{r overview}
case_files <- sort(list.files("tests/cases", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE))
meta <- lapply(case_files, parse_case_header)
overview <- data.frame(
  Case     = vapply(meta, `[[`, "", "id"),
  Status   = status$status[match(vapply(meta, `[[`, "", "id"), status$id)],
  Type     = vapply(meta, `[[`, "", "type"),
  Function = vapply(meta, `[[`, "", "func"),
  Expect   = vapply(meta, function(m) {
    e <- ifelse(is.na(m$expect), "", m$expect)
    if (nchar(e) > 110) paste0(substr(e, 1, 110), "...") else e
  }, "")
)
knitr::kable(overview, row.names = FALSE)
```

# Cases

```{r generate-cases, results='asis'}
# Each case section is assembled from this run's artifacts. Image src paths
# are resolved by pandoc relative to this Rmd (tests/); widths in px match
# 72 px per inch of the case's SIZE so output and reference compare at the
# same scale.
case_block <- function(m) {
  i <- match(m$id, status$id)
  stat <- if (is.na(i)) "?" else status$status[i]
  msg  <- if (is.na(i)) "" else status$msg[i]
  px   <- round(m$width * 72)
  expect <- ifelse(is.na(m$expect), "(no EXPECT header)", m$expect)

  out <- c(sprintf("### %s%s\n", m$id, if (identical(stat, "OK")) "" else " ⚠️"),
           sprintf("> **Expect:** %s\n", expect))

  if (identical(stat, "OK")) {
    out <- c(out, "**Status:** OK\n")
  } else {
    out <- c(out, sprintf("**Status: %s**\n", stat), "````", msg, "````\n")
  }

  # the case source, folded, never evaluated here
  out <- c(out, sprintf('```{r %s, eval=FALSE, code=xfun::read_utf8("tests/cases/%s.R")}\n```\n',
                        m$id, m$id))

  pngs <- list.files("tests/output", sprintf("^%s(-\\d+)?\\.png$", m$id))
  txt  <- file.path("tests/output", paste0(m$id, ".txt"))

  # plots are shown for every case, console cases included — for a console
  # case the plot is informational only (its status is decided by the console
  # diff), and the "no plot" note is the visible sign that nothing rendered
  # (e.g. an error case)
  if (length(pngs) > 0) {
    out <- c(out, "**Output (this run):**\n",
             sprintf('<img src="output/%s" width="%d">\n', pngs, px))
  } else {
    out <- c(out, if (m$type == "console")
               "_No plot produced by this run (expected for error cases)._\n"
             else "_No plot produced by this run (see status above)._\n")
  }

  if (file.exists(txt)) {
    txt_lines <- readLines(txt, warn = FALSE)
    out <- c(out, "**Console output (this run):**\n", "````",
             txt_lines, "````\n")
    # lm_latex cases emit display-math LaTeX ($$...$$); also show it rendered
    # via MathJax so the typeset equation can be eyeballed next to the string.
    if (identical(m$func, "lm_latex")) {
      out <- c(out, "**Rendered:**\n", txt_lines, "\n")
    }
  }

  if (file.exists(file.path("tests/reference", paste0(m$id, ".png")))) {
    out <- c(out, "**Reference (ground truth):**\n",
             sprintf('<img src="reference/%s.png" width="%d">\n', m$id, px))
  }
  out
}

preferred <- c("geom_slice", "geom_fit", "slice_2d", "add_slice_2d",
               "geom_add_slice_2d", "lm_equation", "lm_latex", "error handling")
funcs <- vapply(meta, `[[`, "", "func")
func_order <- c(intersect(preferred, funcs), setdiff(unique(funcs), preferred))

blocks <- character()
for (fn in func_order) {
  blocks <- c(blocks, sprintf("## %s {.tabset .tabset-pills}\n", fn))
  for (i in which(funcs == fn)) blocks <- c(blocks, case_block(meta[[i]]))
}
cat(knitr::knit_child(text = paste(blocks, collapse = "\n"), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
```
